page.overview:
Who is Bix Caleen's father?

A male individual was the father of the mechanic Bix Caleen. At some point by 5 BBY, he caught Cassian Andor climbing over the wall of the Caleen Salyard on Ferrix. Bix's father eventually died and she began to run the salvage yard.
